SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아가씨 내 말 안 들려? 어?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Hey, lady, can't you hear me? Huh?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 小姐，听不见我说话吗？嗯？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 小姐，聽不到我說話嗎？嗯？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: お嬢さん、俺の言ってること聞こえねぇのか？あぁ？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Mba kamu nggak denger omongan saya ya? Hah?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Hã, senhorita, não tá me ouvindo? Hã?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: هی خانم، صدایم را نمی شنوی؟ ها؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Don't make me lose my temper—give me a cigarette~
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 不要逼我罵人，把香煙拿來！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: イライラさせないで、タバコ寄越せよ〜。
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Jangan bikin saya ngomel, kasih rokoknya dong~
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não me faça perder a paciência, só me dá um cigarro~
SCRIPT.SPANISH: No me haga perder la paciencia, solo deme un cigarro~
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: من را از دست ندهید - یک سیگار به من بدهید

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 죄송해요, 그 제품은 지금 재고가 없어요...
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I'm sorry, we're currently out of that product...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: すみません、その銘柄は今在庫がなくて…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Maaf, produk itu lagi nggak ada stoknya...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: متاسفم، ما در حال حاضر از اون محصول خارج شده ایم...

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 어이, 내가 여기서 사간 담배가 몇 갠데.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: How many packs have I bought here?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 喂，我在这买过多少条烟了
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 喂！我在這裡買過多少香煙了
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: おい、俺がここで何箱買ったと思ってんだ。
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Hei, saya udah beli rokok di sini berapa kali
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você sabe quantos cigarros eu já comprei aqui?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: If you don't have it, go get it!!!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ないなら、探してでも持ってこいよ！！！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kalau nggak ada ya cariin dong!!!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Se não tem, dá um jeito de conseguir!
